ov: A black-and-white bear found only in the mountains of central China. It belongs to the carnivore order but lives almost entirely on bamboo, which makes up about 99% of its diet.

why.dg: Usually docile, but giant pandas have attacked people on rare occasions.
why.h: Pandas don’t hibernate. In cold weather they move to lower, warmer elevations instead.

rg: Six mountain regions of central China, mostly in Sichuan, at elevations up to 3,000 m.
df: About 99% bamboo and bamboo shoots: 9–14 kg a day, to make up for how little energy it gets from them.

cf.tip: A red panda is a small reddish-brown animal with a ringed tail. It isn’t a bear, and it is more closely related to raccoons, weasels and skunks.

fx: Its “thumb” is really an elongated wrist bone, which it uses to grip bamboo.
